Marcus Delaney
Director of Manufacturing Engineering | Automotive & Aerospace | Lean Six Sigma Black Belt
Greater Detroit Area

ABOUT
Twenty-two years turning prototypes into production. I have started three greenfield lines and rescued two that were already burning cash. My background is in stamping and body-in-white but the last six years have been mostly assembly automation and vision inspection. I care more about takt time discipline than about any particular technology. People who have worked for me will tell you I am relentless about standard work and impatient with slide decks.

EXPERIENCE
Director of Manufacturing Engineering
Rivian Automotive · Full-time
Jan 2021 - Present · Normal, Illinois
- Led the ME organisation for the R1T body shop through launch, growing the team from 14 to 61 engineers and technicians.
- Owned the capital plan for two additional lines, roughly $180M across FY22 and FY23.
- Cut first-time-through defects on the underbody from 12.4% to 3.1% over eleven months by rebuilding the fixturing standard and retraining the weld engineering group.
- Introduced a daily tiering structure that survived my departure from the plant floor.

Senior Manager, Manufacturing Engineering
General Motors · Full-time
Aug 2014 - Dec 2020 · Lansing, Michigan
- Ran advanced manufacturing engineering for two crossover programmes.
- Deployed vision-based inline inspection across four plants.
- Chaired the corporate stamping die standards committee for three years.

Manufacturing Engineer, then Lead
Ford Motor Company
2003 - 2014 · Dearborn, Michigan

EDUCATION
Michigan Technological University - BSc Mechanical Engineering

SKILLS
Lean Manufacturing · Six Sigma · APQP · PPAP · GD&T · Robot Programming (FANUC, KUKA) · Capital Planning · Team Leadership

Yuki Nakamura
Staff Software Engineer, Distributed Systems
Seattle, Washington

ABOUT
I work on the parts of systems that only get noticed when they break. Consensus, replication, failure detection. I have spent most of my career on storage engines and I keep ending up back there even when I try to leave.

I am at my best on problems where the correct answer is not yet known and somebody has to write down what "correct" even means. I am at my worst on projects where the requirements are settled and the work is execution - I get bored and I am not proud of that.

EXPERIENCE
Staff Software Engineer
Confluent · Full-time
Mar 2022 - Present · Remote
- Core contributor to the tiered storage subsystem in Kafka.
- Designed and shipped the metadata reconciliation protocol that replaced the previous ZooKeeper-backed path.
- Ran the on-call rotation redesign after a Sev-1 that cost us about nine hours of partial unavailability. That incident changed how I think about operational blast radius more than anything else in my career.

Senior Software Engineer
Amazon Web Services · Full-time
Jun 2017 - Feb 2022 · Seattle, Washington
- S3 index team. Worked on the partition-splitting path.
- Wrote the internal design doc for a caching layer that was ultimately not built, which was the right call.

Beatriz Salgado
Head of Talent Acquisition | Scaling teams from 40 to 400
Barcelona, Spain

ABOUT
I build recruiting functions, not requisition queues. Three times now I have joined a company at the point where founder-led hiring stopped working and had to design something that could survive without heroics.

What I actually enjoy is the diagnostic part - working out why a pipeline is failing, which is almost never the sourcing channel everyone blames. Usually it is an unclear scorecard or a hiring manager who cannot describe what good looks like.

I do not believe in employer branding as a substitute for a good interview process. Candidates can tell.

EXPERIENCE
Head of Talent Acquisition
Factorial HR · Full-time
Sep 2021 - Present · Barcelona
- Grew engineering headcount from 63 to 240 across eighteen months while reducing time-to-offer from 41 days to 24.
- Replaced the interview loop end to end: structured scorecards, calibrated interviewers, a work sample that mirrors the actual job.
- Built an internal mobility programme that filled 19% of senior openings from within.

Talent Partner, Engineering
Glovo · Full-time
2018 - 2021 · Barcelona
- Sole technical recruiter for the first year, then built a team of six.

Recruitment Consultant
Michael Page

SKILLS

Kwame Asante
Clinical Operations Leader | Long-Term Care | RN, MSN
Atlanta, Georgia

ABOUT
I have run buildings that were three weeks from a licence revocation and I have run buildings that surveyors used as a reference site. The difference was never the staffing agency contract. It was whether the charge nurses trusted that reporting a problem would not end badly for them.

I came up on the floor. I did eleven years of bedside before I took an administrative role and I still think that is the only reason anyone listens to me.

EXPERIENCE
Director of Nursing
PruittHealth · Full-time
Feb 2020 - Present · Atlanta, Georgia
- 212-bed skilled nursing facility. Accountable for clinical outcomes, survey readiness and a nursing budget of about $14M.
- Took the facility from a two-star to a four-star CMS rating in twenty-six months.
- Reduced RN turnover from 71% annualised to 38% by rebuilding the scheduling model and killing mandatory overtime.
- Zero immediate-jeopardy citations since 2021.

Assistant Director of Nursing
